q: How does a Vapi paper mill work out boiler coal emissions per tonne of paper?
title: Vapi paper mills: boiler coal per tonne
short: Multiply the coal burned by its emission factor, then divide by tonnes of paper made. Senseible's default for coal invoices is 2.42 kg CO2 per kg; a factor from your own coal's lab calorific value is more accurate.
audience: Kraft, duplex and writing paper mills in the Vapi cluster of Gujarat

p: Tonnes of coal from purchase or consumption records.
Multiply by the factor, or by a lab gross calorific value if you have one.
Divide by tonnes of paper made.
If you test the coal's calorific value, a factor from that test is more accurate than a default. Keep the lab reports with the invoices.

example.title: Worked example: one day (illustrative quantities)
example.note: Quantities are illustrative; 2.42 kg CO2 per kg is the default Senseible applies to coal invoices.

senseible: Senseible reads electricity bills (CEA grid factor 0.710 kg CO2 per kWh for FY 2024-25, CO2 Baseline Database version 21.0) and diesel, LPG and gas invoices (IPCC 2006 defaults) into a dated, fingerprinted Scope 1 and 2 record for each site. Intensity per unit uses the activity count you enter, and estimates are labelled as estimates.
